name: What should I do first if I want a kitchen addition?

mainEntity.name: What should I do first if I want a kitchen addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best first step is to define what the addition needs to solve: more storage, a larger cooking area, better flow, or space for eating and entertaining. A contractor can then confirm whether a bump-out, wall removal, or full addition makes sense for your home and lot. In Denver-area projects, this early planning stage should also include budget, timeline, and whether permits or engineering will be needed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start by identifying the problem the addition must solve—space, storage, layout, or entertaining—and then have a contractor evaluate what type of addition fits your home, budget, and site conditions.
